name: Dr Nisheeth Agrawal
bio: Nearly ten years looking after Hunter smiles, with a special interest in veneers, wisdom teeth surgery, dentures and full-mouth rehabilitation.

name: Dr Navneet Karan
bio: A Fellow of the Royal Australasian College of Dental Surgeons, working across Newcastle and the Hunter since 2017. Calm, unhurried, happiest with the tricky cases.

name: Zoe Xu
bio: Preventative and restorative care for every age, from children’s check-ups to gum disease management - and never in a rush to explain things properly.
